1. (Currently Amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, the method comprising:
a. providing a finger palette including:
i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and
ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion, wherein the surface portion is configured to hold a cosmetic product in a quantity sufficient for multiple applications;
b. securing the finger palette to a finger;
c. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette from a container using an applicator tool;
d. spreading or blending the cosmetic product on the surface portion using the applicator tool; and
e. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination using the applicator tool in a controlled manner to apply a reduced quantity of the cosmetic product compared to the quantity initially deposited.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein:
a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion using an applicator tool; and
b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination using the applicator tool in a controlled application process, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity due to controlled dispensing from the surface portion.

5. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. the surface portion extends outwardly from a surface center to an outer perimeter; and
b. the surface portion is free, from any first point on the outer perimeter to any second point on the outer perimeter, of features that could trap cosmetics and complicate cleaning of the surface portion.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without protrusions extending therefrom, and wherein the surface portion is configured to be wiped clean with a single motion across the surface.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar and configured to allow an applicator tool to scrape across the surface in an uninterrupted motion without catching or snagging.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion, and wherein the ring portion is removably and replaceably securable to allow for replacement of the surface portion.
